completeHistoricalProposal.procedure:
KEEP setting a trigger for another spell to activate automatically. NEW create one empty Contingency frame attached to a willing perceived creature within60feet/line of effect,including self. The wrapper costs its actual13RP/Action/components and has its own ordinary counter window. On successful formation it lasts24elapsed hours without concentration;the caster must load it within60elapsed seconds or it expires empty. One frame per originating caster,including empty/loaded frames;successful new formation replaces the old frame and any stored payload without a refund. The bound creature cannot be changed later. This is an explicitly new operational duration in place of Instantaneous metadata.

LOAD:while within60feet/line of effect to the bound creature,the original caster actually casts one separately acquired,fully specified rank0through5ordinary spell with casting time one Action. Pay that spell's actual action,components,consumed materials,RP/cadence and cast-start hooks once. Its actual current costs are not included in the wrapper's13RP. It must lawfully be able to target the bound creature alone or place its entire declared area center/origin on that creature's position;Self-only payloads require the bound creature to be the original caster. At loading,satisfy real source range/touch/target restrictions. Declare all modes,selections and permitted target policy then. No additional selected creature/object outside the eventual area may be named later. A spell that requires unresolved player choices or missing source mechanics cannot be made complete through storage.

NEW storage exception:after the real paid payload cast survives its normal Counterspell window,hold its unresolved main effect in this frame rather than resolving it now. This is one original spell,not a copied free cast. Preparation commits any normal concentration transition and ends the caster's previous concentration when required,even though no ongoing payload concentration is maintained during storage. All costs remain spent. A loading attempt consumes the frame's one loading opportunity;countering or otherwise negating that payload ends the frame rather than leaving an endlessly refillable empty slot. Payload duration starts only on actual release;original generating rank/source/modes and legitimate snapshots remain recorded. Current-at-resolution quantities still use their real source rules when release occurs.

TRIGGER:at wrapper creation specify one future observable event,or at most three simple predicates with fixed AND/OR logic. The frame has only ordinary visual/hearing observation within30feet of its bound creature,using real cover and environmental visibility,and the explicitly NEW ability to read that bound body's own actual HP0/positive-damage/Unconscious transitions. It can also use one fixed elapsed deadline inside its24hours. It cannot inspect intent,alignment,secret membership,unseen inventory,another creature's private resources,spell rank or unchosen future behavior. A spoken passphrase,visible creature entering a declared local radius,or actual bound-body transition can qualify;the sensor is a trigger evaluator,not an intelligence or information feed to the caster. Hidden ineligible trigger facts do not become true by naming them.

Arm only after successful loading. A prior event is not replayed,and an already-true state predicate must genuinely become false then true after arming unless the trigger is a future explicit deadline. A genuine crossing can be caused by the bound creature moving,under ordinary actual geometry. On the first qualifying event,mark the frame and payload spent before queuing release. Finish the current indivisible damage/healing/cast/command event,including its ordinary survival/death consequences;then release in fixed application/identity order. It cannot interrupt that event retroactively or prevent InstantDeath after it already occurred. NEW at most one automatic Contingency release per originating caster per numbered round;outside initiative,no second release until6elapsed seconds after that caster's actual previous release. Preserve that actual history through initiative transitions rather than resetting it. A qualifying trigger while the applicable limit is spent consumes this one-shot frame without a later banked release.

RELEASE:the real unresolved spell originates at the bound creature's current position,an explicit NEW stored-origin permission. Its named target is that same creature,or its predeclared area center/origin is that position;use actual current area geometry and line of effect from there. No remote new target choice or borrowed senses occurs. Apply the spell's real current target eligibility,defenses,save/attack and actual outcome rules. A dead/removed/otherwise illegal target gives a spent failed release,not retargeting or refund. Self-only mechanics still belong only to their legal original caster. The automatic release replaces the payload's ordinary Action commitment because that Action was already paid at loading;it supplies no additional ordinary Action/Bonus Action/Reaction or repeated cast-start/Dissonance event. Bound-creature unconsciousness does not itself prevent an otherwise valid nonconcentration payload.

If the payload requires concentration,the original caster must at release be conscious,able to concentrate,and within60feet/line of effect of the bound creature. Begin that concentration and end any then-current incompatible concentration immediately before resolution;failure of this requirement consumes the release without effect. A stored nonconcentration payload can release while its living original caster is elsewhere/unconscious,subject to all real frame/target protections. Original caster death ends the frame;it cannot create a posthumous second source/controller. The bound creature's death alone is a genuine event,not permission for an ineligible healing spell to resurrect it. A successful outcome triggers only the real original spell's eligible resolution hooks once.

Release is not a new spell cast and opens no second ordinary Counterspell window;countering at loading,dispelling/suppressing the frame before release,and actual defenses remain meaningful. A prophecy can report the real pending release without reopening an old counter window. Remove an actual still-loaded rank-six frame and its unresolved stored payload ends;no resource is recovered. Suppression blocks sensing and release while the original deadlines continue. The bound body and original caster must remain on the same actually established plane for the frame to sense/release;an unknown or different relation makes it inactive without a diagnostic. This creates no cross-plane communication or new cosmological topology. Missed transient events are lost;an already-true state on return is not a fresh crossing. A fixed deadline missed during suppression/inactivity expires the frame's chance rather than firing late. A genuine later qualifying event can trigger a still-armed unspent frame within the original lifetime.

No payload may create/load another Contingency or another deferred automatic-cast store,or copy/replay an already stored spell. For multiple preexisting frames whose releases cause later genuine events,process each actual frame at most once;the dispatch set is the finite set armed before the originating external event,so a newly created frame cannot join that same chain. Every frame retains its real owner/round cap. This finite queue rule is expressly proposed,not proof of a completed scheduler. No item gem,unpriced component,free daily refill,new repertoire or hidden-fact oracle is imported from another game.

Reviewed Glyph of Warding already has a complete,distinct procedure:one writable noncreature surface,one-minute concentration,one subsequent bodily touch or actually visible entry trigger,and one finite alarm/repulsion/ward payload included in its ordinary casting cost. It explicitly does not store another spell or create a permanent trap. Its retained moving-anchor history,ordinary observation,consume-before-payload and missed-suppression-event rules inform this comparison;they do not authorize Contingency's new24-hour storage,body-state sensing,remote stored origin or separately paid loading exception. If a legal Glyph is selected as the payload under the current target policy,it still needs its actual surface target;this creature/area-only Contingency policy does not supply one,so that particular loading is ineligible. Neither card gains the other card's access or components.
workedCases: TU6-11-A: A Wizard starts with40RP,pays13for the frame and later5for a legal rank-three Action payload,leaving22before other costs. The payload has its real counter window while loading. When the declared bound-body event later occurs,the one held effect resolves automatically after that whole event,with no second Action,RP charge or cast-start hook. The original13+5are never refunded if the frame expires unused.

TU6-11-B: A stored legal healing payload is triggered when the bound creature reaches0HP. It waits until the damage packet and any InstantDeath decision finish;it cannot rewrite a completed death as prevention. Suppressing the frame during a transient trigger loses that event,not stores it for later. A concentration payload also fails spent if its original caster cannot satisfy the actual release concentration/range requirements.
completeHistoricalProposal.newChoices: NEW one-shot24-hour frame,60-second loading window,separately paid rank0-5Action payload,bounded local/body triggers,stored-origin automatic release and finite source-preserving event queue.
completeHistoricalProposal.originalQuestion: Preserve setting a TRIGGER FOR ANOTHER SPELL TO ACTIVATE AUTOMATICALLY,Core Action/60ft/Instantaneous. Supply finite trigger duration,legal spell rank and ownership/repertoire,actual payment/components and when the stored spell is cast versus held pending. Define trigger predicates and lawful observable information,one-shot versus repeat charges,recipient/range checks at release,event ordering,counter windows,concentration transition and what happens on invalid target/interruption. Automation cannot grant hidden-fact sensing,unpaid casts,unbounded chain reactions or duplicate uses of a stored source. Decide whether normal Action costs are replaced by the printed automatic activation and how that interacts with per-round/class cadence. Preserve spent RP and work across suppression,dispel,expiration and changing caster state; no external-game spell/rank/component restrictions imported silently.

completeCurrentCard.procedure:
KEEP Universal rank6,Action,60feet,V/S/F,base13RP and automatic activation of another spell. NEW one nonconcentration frame on one actually willing perceived living creature, including self, with line of effect. Fix the same bound identity and complete trigger at wrapper commitment. Successful formation starts original24elapsed-hour expiry and a60-second loading deadline. One frame, empty or loaded, per original caster; only a successful new formation replaces the old. A failed/countered wrapper pays but does not replace. These lifetimes are expressly new instead of Core Instantaneous.
LOAD: the original caster, within60feet/LoE, commits one actual separately acquired rank0-5 ORDINARY spell with one-Action casting time. It must actually be legal NOW to target the bound creature alone or place its complete declared area origin/center on that creature; Self-only requires bound=caster. Fix full spell/grant, mode, same target or bound-area policy, any explicit exclusions, shape, components, resource costs and source-specific choices BEFORE its counter window. Satisfy native touch/range/life/consent/material prerequisites; the frame does not provide them. It cannot store a nonspell class heal, object-only glyph, missing profile, unpriced material effect or unresolved discretionary payload. Real spell-tagged class cards remain outside this expressly ordinary-storage design rather than being charged as ordinary aliases.
Pay the payload's real Action, RP/material/HP/uses, components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transition and beginning hooks once at LOAD; wrapper13RP does not include it. The first legal loading commitment consumes the loading opportunity. A countered/negated load ends that frame with no refill/refund. Known ineligible load does not commit and can be corrected before the original deadline. After its counter window the same ORIGINAL cast is stored unresolved. For a concentrating payload prospective loading concentration displaces the old source; successful storage then relinquishes only that prospective burden. Storage holds no concentration and never restores the displaced old source. Loading-time rank, legitimate class parameters, required costs and explicit choices are immutable; future target defenses/eligibility, current lawful geometry and source-specified resolution-time quantities remain current. Payload duration starts on actual release. Independent use/capture deadlines are not extended by the frame.
TRIGGER: one observable future event or at most three declared simple predicates in fixed AND/OR logic; ordinary sight/hearing within30feet of the actual bound body with real cover/environment, plus the explicit LOCAL sensor of that body's own positive-to-zero HP crossing, positive defended-damage event or Unconscious transition, or one fixed future deadline strictly before frame expiry. No intent, alignment, private external inventory, spell rank or unavailable senses. Fix actual observer/eye/ear body points; no wall penetration or sight inside an opaque body. No sensing feed is sent to the caster. Arm only after successful LOAD; an old event or already-true predicate is never replayed. State predicates need a real false-to-true transition after arming.
QUEUE: at the beginning of the independently occurring external event capture the finite set of genuinely armed frames. Complete that entire damage/healing/cast/command event, its native source-owned children and survival/death/concentration consequences before any queued frame output. Evaluate its recorded observable facts, then in immutable establishment/identity order atomically consume each qualifying frame and payload before attempting release. NEW cap: at most one Contingency release ATTEMPT per original caster per actual numbered round; outside initiative require six elapsed seconds from that caster's previous attempt, preserving both interval/round histories through a mode transition. No reset through relabelled encounter or callbacks. A matching frame when the allowance is spent is consumed without a queued later chance. A release invalidated after reservation keeps that reservation spent. Recursively caused events can examine only the original finite prearmed set, each frame at most once; newly created/loaded frames cannot join that dispatch chain. A payload cannot create/load another automatic store, replay/copy an existing stored cast or generate another Action/turn window through an unaccepted route.
RELEASE: after the causing event, recheck same identity, lawful payload eligibility, actual source protections and original clocks. Use a declared current body point on the bound creature as the automatic spell origin; fixed single recipient is that creature, or its original predeclared area center/origin follows that body. No new chosen recipient, exclusion, mode, source grant or retargeting. Original caster remains dealer/controller. Self restrictions remain. A dead/ineligible recipient consumes failure without resurrection. A nonconcentration payload may release with an unconscious but living original caster and conscious or unconscious eligible recipient; caster death ends the frame. Caster and bound body must have an actually established same-plane relation, without inventing a plane or granting a private diagnostic.
For concentrating output, before resolution require the original caster conscious and actually able to concentrate within60feet/LoE; replace its then-current incompatible concentration once. If ineligible, consume without an effect. A successful automatic release is NOT a new cast, Action, Reaction, payment, component/cadence event or counter window. The original successful-resolution hooks run once only when their genuine predicate is met. Actual removal/defenses remain real counterplay.
NEW SOURCE-ROOT CHECKPOINT: LOAD creates the stored cast and its payment/selection receipt but no unperformed damage root. At actual release when an original payload creates each genuine damage/healing operation, create its native source-owned root then, with the ORIGINAL caster and that caster's real Null state at this root's creation. Keep its shared rolls, target application identity and already-frozen flags through redirects/descendants. This is a Contingency-only mapping, not alteration of Mental Prison's one admission root or Spectral Army's later-discharge rule. Other source-owned quantities/currency use the actual paid LOAD basis, never wrapper+payload nominal total. No duplicate callback or release ID can create another root, consumption or reward.
Suppression disables real frame sensing/release while original deadlines run. The frame remains actually removable at its bound-body application under a source-qualified rank-six interface. It does not create an empty-position anchor. Expiry/true removal cancels the frame and unresolved payload permanently. A missed transient event is lost; resuming while a state is already true is not a new transition. A sole fixed deadline missed during suppression/inactivity consumes the chance, not delayed firing. An armed frame with other still-available declared future predicates can remain until its genuine ending, without replay. At equality the frame's original expiry precedes trigger admission. No storage may outlive an earlier applicable native permission.
GRAVE GIFT is current accepted ordinary rank5 source, not an unnamed ordinary heal. At LOAD its donor must have at least2normalHP, pay floor(currentHP/2) plus actual10baseRP, and its other actually willing living ally must ALREADY be0HP Dying/Stable. The frame grants no automatic unconscious consent. Healthy-target preload is illegal before payment. A positive-to-zero trigger requires real recovery then a NEW drop after arming; loading at0 does not replay the prior drop. A changed future-deadline example must be labelled changed. At release direct max-HP recovery is not ordinary healing: preserve Wounds/Critical, independent Prone, actual broad HP-gain prohibition, source-specific False Life optional Insight/d2 gate and separately authorized stabilization with one actual original Stable deadline. Ordinary class Healing Rite may be a separately paid intervening recovery but is not a stored ordinary payload. No Cure Wounds or unspecified spell is invented.
Glyph of Warding remains its complete distinct paid surface/finite-payload source: it does not supply this frame's creature binding,24-hour duration, separate load, remote origin or new root mapping. All of these storage permissions are explicitly local new authorship, not proof of a generic temporal/cast scheduler.

completeSharedRules.wording: All five use their complete native classAccess row: actual class level, school, rank and base RP; no total-level, discounted-price or same-name substitution grants access. A legal commitment spends its real Action/Bonus Action/Reaction permission, actual final RP/material/HP/charge price, components and source-use ledgers once, sets any prospective concentration and ends incompatible old concentration before interruption, then updates actual chronological casting-family, Dissonance/Refrain and beginning hooks before its Counterspell window. Ordinary success, failure, countering and later ineligibility refund nothing. A resumed parent never overwrites an intervening Reaction cast's later history. Save DC and attacks use the actual generating class and acquired automatic features. No spell here grants its required anatomy, inventory, repertoire, proficiency, extra Action or physical support.

completeSharedRules.classification: INHERIT plus explicit per-spell clock registrations
completeSharedRules.title: Markers, life and idempotent event history
completeSharedRules.wording: Bind absolute time and source/recipient original regular START/END markers separately. A future target END excludes an already-underway target turn; a source next START means its first future original regular START. Preserve that clock through reordering, absence, suppression and initiative changes under the accepted virtual-marker rule; outside-initiative one-round registrations use the specified original elapsed six seconds, never a reset on entering initiative. Expire START-ending effects before refresh; then actual Reaction/recharge, legal already-due life recovery, death save, other required START events and only then voluntary decisions. END damage/saves/maintenance precede END-expiry. A resolved marker/event cannot be repeated. A real full Action grant retains its original cap and recursive-grant restriction. No new generic timeline, Time Loop restoration, world rewind, turn duplication or source reset is selected. Every fixture explicitly supplies its schedule and ordinary-round identity; elapsed seconds alone are not a universal round-number formula.

completeSharedRules.classification: NEW LOCAL common wording only for Absolute Zero and Chrono Lock
completeSharedRules.title: Finite body suspension, not generic Incapacitated
completeSharedRules.wording:
When one of these two spells actually establishes its suspension, the same active creature is unaware, cannot speak, choose voluntary behavior, act, use Bonus Actions/Reactions, move, command or perform voluntary upkeep. Hold the actual body and currently worn/carried inanimate equipment at its current pose. Other carried/mounted creatures are not suspended by association. Existing external supports can break; ordinary gravity, forced movement and ordinary teleportation cannot relocate the held body while operative. A source explicitly overriding this suspension remains an exact exception. No attack advantage, automatic STR/DEX failure, adjacent critical, Prone, Stunned or generic Incapacitated is implied.
The held body/gear admits no new bodily damage, healing, temporary HP, conditions, direct HP loss, transformation or physical alteration. An otherwise legal paid attempt may resolve no bodily payload; nothing is banked. Distinguish genuine damage prevention from loss of source eligibility. Every actual due periodic opportunity is consumed once even when its bodily payload is prevented; independent source clocks, END saves for an existing source, scheduled source cleanup, mandatory form ending and world state continue. A mandatory anatomy ending can become a pending body-normalization consequence until interaction resumes; it never resets that source's timer or grants a new form.
Death saves due during operative suspension are marked skipped without a roll, success or failure and cannot be rerolled for that same regular marker later. Absolute Stable recovery remains its ORIGINAL due deadline: while HP gain is blocked keep a due-blocked record, not a new d4 or renewed delay. After suspension, the first genuine legal recovery checkpoint under the existing life/START ordering resolves that original opportunity once. No new recovery is granted by this spell. Explicit world-timed lethal tracks and their real death rules continue: a genuine lethal track transition can kill despite prevented damage/HP change, and true death/removal ends this application. Immediate biological aging, respiration expenditure and metabolism pause; elapsed world calendars, actual deprivation/debt/history continue, and there is no food, water, rest, work, study or recovery credit.
Existing concentration is not lost merely because this is not Incapacitated. Actual deadline, source dependency, unpaid upkeep, death or another real ending still ends it. Body-emitted aura/technique output and optional command/control are unavailable while held; completed independent fields/projectiles and other bodies retain their actual sources. Missed emissions do not queue. A required further personal action cannot complete; a completely committed independent effect resolves only if its own continuing predicates remain.
The temporal application remains a real rank-six removable/suppressible effect at the actual body. Eligible removal requires its real source target/range/perception or actual area-capture interface; no hidden locator is granted. Actual suppression restores ordinary interaction while the original deadline and hard-admission record continue. Resumption before that deadline captures the same surviving active identity at its CURRENT real pose, not its old position; it heals nothing, resets nothing and never spends another hard guard. An actually ended/dead/removed source cannot resume. On final ending real unsupported height uses the existing Falling marker. No detachable ice, material stock, stored-damage burst, native-plane or soul claim is created.

With none, absence still ends into an explicit returned-placement conflict, not further invulnerability, remote teleportation, crushing damage or a new body. Permanent gear/corpse identity and actual custody are conserved.
